description: This file defines the InventoryWorker class, which provides static utility methods for managing and querying inventory and purchase order data in the OFBiz framework. The methods include fetching outstanding purchase orders, calculating net outstanding quantities, and aggregating product quantities across orders.

classes.name: InventoryWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for inventory and purchase order processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all outstanding (non-cancelled, non-rejected, non-completed) purchase orders for a specific productId.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchasedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the net outstanding ordered quantity for a specific productId by summing quantities from outstanding purchase orders, accounting for cancellations.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantities
methods.description: Returns a map of productIds to their respective outstanding quantities for a given order type, filtering out completed, rejected, or canceled orders.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForSalesOrders
methods.description: Retrieves outstanding quantity map specifically for sales orders for specified productIds.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Retrieves outstanding quantity map specifically for purchase orders for specified productIds.
